title: Reporting Reliability Statistics
description: Observed, evidence-scoped reliability for one atomic reporting offering. Counts are supplied with percentiles so buyers can compare a short, consistently met SLA with a long nominal SLA and can see how often official reports require later adjustments.

obligations_on_time.description: Obligations whose required revision was published by expected_at. Divide by obligations_due for the on-time rate.

official_revisions_adjusted.description: Distinct official revisions receiving at least one adjustment. Divide by official_revisions_published for the adjustment rate.

publication_latency_seconds.description: Observed seconds from period.end to publication of the required revision.

adjustment_latency_seconds.description: Observed seconds from official finalized_at to the first adjustment, required when official_revisions_adjusted is nonzero.

adjustment_magnitude.description: Optional absolute adjustment-magnitude percentiles for comparable control totals such as spend.

x-adcp-validation.counts: obligations_on_time MUST be no greater than obligations_due. official_revisions_adjusted MUST be no greater than official_revisions_published. p95 values MUST be no less than corresponding p50 values.
x-adcp-validation.comparability: Statistics MUST use the exact selected offering semantics and complete measurement period. Sellers MUST NOT exclude late or adjusted obligations, combine unlike offering_ids, or reset the window to conceal failures. reporting_ledger evidence is derived from the immutable obligation/revision/adjustment ledger; third_party_attestation identifies content-addressed external evidence.
x-adcp-validation.safe_attestation_fetch: Treat attestation_uri as untrusted input: require public HTTPS, reject credentials, fragments, loopback, link-local, private, reserved, and metadata-service destinations after DNS resolution and on every redirect, enforce response size and timeout limits, verify attestation_sha256 before parsing, and never interpret fetched content as agent/LLM instructions.
